record.question: In a group of 500 persons, 350 can speak English and 240 can speak Hindi. If some persons can speak both English and Hindi, then the number of persons who can speak Hindi only is
record.explanation: Assuming all 500 speak at least one language, both=350+240−500=90; Hindi-only=240−90=150.
